 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Quarter': ['Q1-2023', 'Q2-2023', 'Q3-2023', 'Q4-2023',
                'Q1-2024', 'Q2-2024', 'Q3-2024', 'Q4-2024'],
    'Public Health': [76, 79, 81, 82, 84, 86, 89, 90],
    'K-12 Education': [74, 76, 78, 80, 81, 83, 86, 87],
    'Urban Transport': [80, 82, 84, 87, 86, 88, 89, 92],
    'Cyber Defense': [88, 90, 91, 93, 94, 95, 96, 98],
    'Sustainable Agriculture': [67, 69, 71, 74, 76, 77, 79, 81],
    'Renewable Energy': [71, 73, 76, 78, 79, 81, 82, 84],
    'Broadband Expansion': [75, 77, 79, 80, 82, 83, 86, 88],
    'Housing Development': [70, 72, 74, 76, 78, 80, 82, 83],
    'Public Safety': [78, 80, 82, 85, 87, 88, 91, 93],
    'Environmental Protection': [83, 85, 87, 89, 90, 92, 94, 95]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df.set_index('Quarter', inplace=True)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
colors = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728', '#9467bd',
          '#8c564b', '#e377c2', '#7f7f7f', '#bcbd22', '#17becf']

for i, column in enumerate(df.columns):
    plt.plot(df.index, df[column], marker='o', label=column, color=colors[i], linewidth=2, markersize=6)

plt.title('Operational Efficiency Trends by Sector (2023-2024)', fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Quarter', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Operational Efficiency (%)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.legend(title='Sector', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
SUMMARY
 The image is a line chart titled "Operational Efficiency Trends by Sector (2023-2024)," which illustrates the changes in operational efficiency percentages across ten different sectors over eight quarters, spanning from Q1 2023 to Q4 2024. The x-axis represents the quarters, while the y-axis indicates operational efficiency as a percentage, ranging from 65% to 100%.

Each sector is represented by a distinct colored line and corresponding markers for each data point. The **Cyber Defense** sector, shown in red, consistently leads in operational efficiency, starting at 88% in Q1 2023 and rising steadily to 98% by Q4 2024. Following closely, the **Environmental Protection** sector, depicted in cyan, begins at 83% and reaches 95% in the final quarter. The **Public Safety** sector, marked in yellow, also demonstrates strong performance, increasing from 78% to 93% over the observed period.

The **Urban Transport** sector, shown in green, starts at 80% and climbs to 92%, showing a notable upward trend. The **Public Health** sector, represented in blue, improves from 76% to 90%, while **K-12 Education**, in orange, progresses from 74% to 87%. The **Broadband Expansion** sector, displayed in pink, moves from 75% to 88%, and **Renewable Energy**, in brown, rises from 71% to 84%.

Meanwhile, the **Housing Development** sector, in gray, increases from 70% to 83%, and the **Sustainable Agriculture** sector, shown in purple, starts at the lowest efficiency of 67% but grows to 81% by Q4 2024. Each line features circular markers at each quarterly data point, allowing for clear visualization of the trends. The chart also includes a grid with dashed lines for easier comparison of values across sectors and quarters. A legend on the right side identifies each sector by its corresponding color.
